coaching.headline: The template win: objectives 25–11, Fangtooth at 7, Prime and Orb both ours at 28–29, towers 7–4. Macro, start to finish.
coaching.team: This is what to repeat — we took the early Fangtooth, controlled the mid-game Prime/Orb, and translated it straight to towers. Khaimera's favored jungle matchup and Sparrow's 11-kill carry game anchored it. Anti-heal was light (1 vs one healer) but the snowball was fast enough it didn't matter. Bank this shape.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Close to our ceiling: early Fangtooth, Prime/Orb control, and a 25-11 objective lead converted straight to towers — with one fix left: the 4.3, 9.8 and 14.8 fights were lost around pinned lanes, and only 2 of 5 won fights cashed.

perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera, favored into Grux, controlled neutrals and the objective timings — the engine of the 25-11 macro win. Keep setting those objective timings.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow (11/6) despite the unfavored read vs Eden — steady carry that the objective leads converted to a win.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wraith took an unfavored mid read into Gideon and still went 4/3/6 while the team won the macro game.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Skylar offlane, 5/2/2 low-death in a lane read theirs all game — Willy Guggenheim turned a losing read into 11063 objective damage.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Riktor into a favored Zinx, 12 assists — good engage that helped control the objective timings in a 25-11 macro win.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

eden.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Kinetic Waltz, crest Pacifier
lines: Eden dealt 24,780 hero damage, 23% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Riktor (level 17 estimated: about 222 physical armor, 210 after penetration) and Khaimera (level 17 estimated: about 93 physical armor, 81 after penetration) that is about 4% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
Kinetic Waltz (augment): Axiom Strike deals 90% damage, has 30% reduced cooldown and grants 35% movement speed for 1.5s when damaging Enemy Heroes.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; 1,834 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Dust Devil, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Pacifier.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Eden killed built physical armor (Riktor). Anti-heal on Sparrow. We killed Eden 7 times.

Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 43.1% in 615 Eden carry games, below the hero's 50.3%; this 3-item core: 57.4% in 54 games, above the 56.4% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

zinx.loadout: Exarch (Preservation + Fervour), augment Terminal Treatment, crest Tranquility
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 792 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Zinx support players this patch (23% of the team's). The damage came from Prophecy, Orion, Tainted Totem.
Neural Regenesis at top rank: 120s base, about 80s by the end (33% shorter) from 50 ability haste: Prophecy 15, Spectra 10, Orion 15, Tainted Totem 10.
Zinx dealt 24,553 hero damage, 23% of their team's, with +200 magical power from items.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Tainted Totem (item): On dealing damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tranquility (crest): Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s.
Exarch (Eternal): Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.
Terminal Treatment (augment): Refibrillator's On-Hit damage increases by 0-25%, based on Target's Missing Health.

Sustain: Tainted Totem: On dealing damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.; Tainted Totem: On Healing and Shielding Allies: Grant them Blighted Touch for 4s.; Tranquility: Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s.; Preservation: Healing or shielding you receive is increased by 10%.; Fervour: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).; 10,568 healing recorded.
Toughness: +300 health; took 27,051 damage, mitigated 14,942, died 7 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 6 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Spectra, Orion, Exarch, Fervour, Terminal Treatment.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Tainted Totem, Tranquility, Exarch, Preservation, Fervour.
The Eternal was part of it: Exarch (Preservation + Fervour) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 2 players Zinx killed built magical armor (Riktor). Anti-heal on Sparrow. We killed Zinx 7 times.

Copy it? Exarch (Preservation + Fervour): 49% in 149 Zinx support games, above the hero's 48%; this 3-item core: 50.2% in 267 games, below the 52.5% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

card.lesson: Neural Regenesis came back about every 80s instead of 120s by the end (33% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

khaimera.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Jungle Invasion, crest Razorback
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 916 hero damage a minute, more than 79% of Khaimera jungle players this patch (28% of the team's). The damage came from Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Razorback.
Cull at top rank: 60s base, about 46.2s by the end (23% shorter) from 30 ability haste: Void Helm 10, Basilisk 20.
Khaimera dealt 28,397 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +105 physical power from items.

Penetration: Manta Scythe 10; against Zinx (level 17 estimated: about 105 physical armor, 95 after penetration) and Eden (level 17 estimated: about 112 physical armor, 102 after penetration) that is about 5% and 5% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Manta Scythe (item): Against Enemy Units within 2500u: If they have no Ally within 1000u of themselves, deal 8% more damage to them.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Razorback (crest): Gain 20% Physical Armor and Magical Armor for 5s. Reflect 15% of Pre-Mitigated Damage received from Heroes as Damage.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Void Helm: Heal 20% more from all sources.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 13,460 healing recorded.
Toughness: +880 health, +8 physical armor, +50 magical armor; took 54,778 damage, mitigated 41,563, died 5 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Void Helm, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Khaimera killed built physical armor (Iggy & Scorch). Anti-heal on Zinx, Gideon. We killed Khaimera 5 times.
Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 49.5% in 2,930 Khaimera jungle games, below the hero's 51.7%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
